faq.q: What is included in a marbella sunset photoshoot yacht session 2027?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA. The boat is yours for the duration – you bring your own photographer or hire one locally.

faq.q: Which boats are best for a sunset photoshoot in Marbella?
faq.a: The Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are ideal for small groups. Both depart from Puerto Banús and offer spacious decks for photos. Larger groups can opt for the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) from €4,719 for 4 hours.

faq.q: How much does a sunset photoshoot yacht session cost in 2027?
faq.a: Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B boats like the Mangusta 80 start at €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter. All prices include skipper, drinks, snacks, and taxes.

faq.q: Do you provide a photographer for the photoshoot?
faq.a: No, we are a boat charter company. You are welcome to bring your own photographer or hire one through local Marbella services. Our crew can assist with positioning the boat for the best light during golden hour.

faq.q: What time does the sunset photoshoot session start?
faq.a: Sunset times vary by season – typically between 18:30 and 21:30 (CEST). We recommend a 2-hour charter starting 60–90 minutes before sunset to capture the golden hour and twilight. We can adjust departure time to your preference.

faq.q: Can I bring my own food and drinks on the yacht?
faq.a: Yes, you are welcome to bring additional food and drinks. The included package already provides water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. No extra catering fee applies.

faq.q: What is the cancellation policy for a photoshoot yacht session?
faq.a: Cancellations made 48 hours or more before departure receive a full refund. Within 48 hours, a 50% charge applies. No-shows are non-refundable. Weather-related cancellations are fully refundable or reschedulable.

faq.q: Are there any age restrictions for the sunset photoshoot yacht session?
faq.a: No age restrictions – children are welcome. Life jackets are available for all sizes. The skipper will brief everyone on safety before departure.

data.body_html:
Capture the Costa del Sol at its most photogenic with a marbella sunset photoshoot yacht session 2027. Whether it is an engagement, a birthday, a brand campaign, or simply a set of stunning holiday portraits, the golden light over the Mediterranean transforms every frame. Departing from Puerto Banús, our fleet offers spacious decks, sleek lines, and uninterrupted views of La Concha mountain and the Marbella coastline. No photographer is included – you bring your own or hire one locally – but the boat, skipper, drinks, and snacks are all taken care of.

Why a sunset photoshoot on a yacht works

Sunset on the Costa del Sol lasts roughly 45–60 minutes of golden hour, followed by 20–30 minutes of blue twilight. A 2-hour charter gives you both phases without rushing. The Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) provide clean, uncluttered backdrops – white upholstery, teak decks, and reflective water. You control the angles by moving between the bow, flybridge, and aft deck. Our licensed skipper handles the navigation and can position the boat with the sun behind the subject or reflecting off the sea.

Our recommended boats for your session

For small groups (up to 9–11 guests), the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 are the most cost-effective options. Both are Tier A boats at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. For larger groups or a more dramatic backdrop, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) starts at €4,719 for 4 hours and includes a free jet ski. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and Spanish IVA. You can see the full fleet at our [boat rental Marbella](/experiences/) page.

What is included in every charter

  • Licensed skipper (English and Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the full charter duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (chips, nuts, olives)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

You are welcome to bring additional food and drinks. No extra catering fee applies.

Photographer tips for the best results

Bring a lens with a wide aperture (f/1.8 or faster) for creamy bokeh on the water. A polarising filter reduces glare from the sea and deck. Shoot in RAW to handle the dynamic range between sky and shadow. The flybridge of the Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m, 12 pax) offers elevated angles, while the bow of the Mangusta 80 gives a clean, uninterrupted foreground. For group shots, the aft deck with the setting sun behind creates a natural rim light.

Where you will cruise

All sessions depart from Puerto Banús. Typical routes head west towards the Golden Mile and Marbella Marina, or east past Cabopino and Cala del Faro. The skipper can adjust the route to avoid other boats and find the cleanest backdrop. If you want landmarks like La Concha or the Marbella skyline in the frame, let us know in advance. We also offer longer charters to Estepona or Sotogrande if you prefer a different coastline.

Reserve your marbella sunset photoshoot yacht session 2027 by contacting us via WhatsApp or through our [Marbella boat rental](/experiences/) page. We require a 50% deposit to secure the date; the balance is due 48 hours before departure. Cancellations made 48 hours or more ahead receive a full refund. Weather-related cancellations are fully refundable or reschedulable.
